# Gilbert Blythe

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Appearance

Gilbert Blythe is a tall boy with curly brown hair and hazel eyes. His eyes often carry a roguish, half-shy, or half-eager expression. He typically features a mouth twisted into a teasing smile.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P32](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0032)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever and good-natured young man who holds his own independent thoughts about the world. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life while putting his best into it, he maintains a friendly spirit of rivalry and is recognized by others as kind and thoughtful.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe returned to school in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after spending three years in Alberta with his sick father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick). On his first day back in class, he attempted to get [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's attention by pulling her hair and calling her "Carrots," prompting her to smash her slate over his head and refuse his attempts to apologize. The incident sparked a fierce, long-running academic rivalry between them through their school years and preparation for the Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) entrance examinations. Despite their feud, Gilbert rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when her boat began leaking during a play reenactment on a pond, though she rejected his offer to end their quarrel. When [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later nearly succumbed to stage fright during a benefit concert recitation, catching sight of Gilbert reignited her determination to deliver a glowing performance. He continued his intense rivalry with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), ultimately winning the school medal while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) won the Avery scholarship. Upon learning that [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) was losing her eyesight and needed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to remain at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Gilbert generously gave up his appointed position as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) schoolteacher so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could take the job, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to finally forgive him and become a close friend.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Quotes

> “All right!” Gilbert sprang into his skiff with an angry color in his cheeks. “I’ll never ask you to be friends again, Anne Shirley. And I don’t care either!”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P34](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0034)

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began as bitter enemies after Gilbert publicly mocked her red hair, leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash a slate over his head and refuse his initial apologies. Their dynamic evolved into an intense academic rivalry at school, though Gilbert later rescued [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) from a leaking boat when she was stranded on a bridge pile. Although [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) initially rejected his attempt to end their feud following the rescue, they eventually reconciled to become close friends and study partners.

- Friend of — reconciled childhood friends and study partners  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)</sub>
- Rival of — academic rivals competing for top standing  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. A Concert, a Catastrophe, and a Confession P32](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0032), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), +6 more</sub>
- Saved — rescued her from bridge pile using dory  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P26](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0026), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P38](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0038)</sub>

### [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/gilbert-blythe--shirley.md)

Gilbert maintains an intense academic rivalry with [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) as they constantly compete for top marks in school. Their scholastic competition culminates at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Gilbert wins the coveted medal while [Shirley](../character/shirley.md) secures the Avery scholarship.

- Rival of — intense academic rivalry for top marks in school  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)</sub>
